# CEO Turbo

> CEO Turbo (ceoturbo.com) is an Atlanta, Georgia growth agency founded by Christopher Robinson (StackmodeChris). It builds websites, runs Meta, Google, TikTok and X ads, sets up and optimizes Google Business Profiles and social media profiles, designs promotional email campaigns, and does SEO, AEO and GEO for independent artists, local service businesses and Shopify stores. It offers a free online SEO, AEO and GEO visibility audit (https://www.ceoturbo.com/free-audit) and sells NFC Google review cards (from $24.99, ships from Atlanta) that open a business's Google review form with one tap (https://www.ceoturbo.com/google-review-cards). Free 30-minute "Brand Boost" growth calls are booked at https://cal.com/stackmodechris/ceoturbo-brandboost.

Key facts:
- 20 live client websites, including Mor Handy, Appliance King, OJ Junk Removal, Kingstone Landscaping, Phoenix Freedom Firearms, BIGZO, 7UVHAVIN and Beyond Labels Gifts.
- Meta lead campaigns (Jul–Oct 2026): 147 leads for $1,103.43, $7.51 average cost per lead, lowest $4.31.
- Artist profile campaign (BIGZO): 165 profile visits at $0.32 each.
- Based at 8735 Dunwoody Place #12143, Atlanta, GA 30350; serves clients across the United States.

- [NFC Google Review Cards — Tap to Review, from $24.99](https://www.ceoturbo.com/google-review-cards): Customers tap their phone and your Google review form opens. iPhone & Android, no app, no subscription. From $24.99, free US shipping.

- [SEO vs AEO vs GEO: The Difference, Explained Simply](https://www.ceoturbo.com/guides/seo-vs-aeo-vs-geo): SEO ranks you, AEO makes you quotable, GEO makes AI trust you. A plain-English breakdown with a checklist for each — and which one to start with.
- [Facebook Ads Cost Per Lead for Local Businesses — Real 2026 Data](https://www.ceoturbo.com/guides/facebook-ads-cost-per-lead): Real Meta lead-form results from 7 campaigns: $4.31 to $19.91 per lead, $7.51 average across 147 leads — and what drove the cheapest ones.
- [How to Get Your Business Recommended by ChatGPT (2026)](https://www.ceoturbo.com/guides/how-to-get-recommended-by-chatgpt): Seven steps to raise your odds of being named by ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini: crawl access, answer-first pages, consistent facts and original data.

- [How to Get More Spotify Listeners as an Independent Artist](https://www.ceoturbo.com/guides/how-to-get-more-spotify-listeners): A practical plan to grow monthly listeners: fix your profiles, pitch every release, use pre-saves, run small ads and turn listeners into fans.
- [Shopify Visitors But No Sales? 9 Fixes That Work](https://www.ceoturbo.com/guides/shopify-visitors-no-sales): Why a Shopify store gets traffic but no sales — unclear offer, weak product pages, surprise costs, wrong traffic — and nine fixes to try in order.
- [Local Business Website Checklist — 12 Things That Get Calls](https://www.ceoturbo.com/guides/local-business-website-checklist): The 12 things a local service business website needs to turn visitors into calls: tap-to-call, service area, prices, proof, speed and schema.
- [How to Get More Google Reviews (Without Breaking the Rules)](https://www.ceoturbo.com/how-to-get-more-google-reviews): Ask every customer at the moment the job ends, make it one tap with your review link or an NFC card, and reply to every review. The rules and the setup.
- [NFC Google Review Cards: Do They Work? (2026 Guide)](https://www.ceoturbo.com/guides/nfc-google-review-cards): How NFC Google review cards work, which phones read them, how they compare to QR codes and stands, what they cost, and how to get the most reviews.
- [How to Find Your Google Review Link in 2 Minutes](https://www.ceoturbo.com/guides/how-to-find-google-review-link): Get the direct link that opens your Google review form, from a phone or computer — plus the link mistakes that send customers to your listing instead.
- [Do NFC Review Cards Work With iPhone & Android?](https://www.ceoturbo.com/guides/nfc-review-card-iphone-android): Which iPhones and Android phones read NFC review cards, where to tap, how to turn NFC on, and what to do when a phone doesn't react.
- [What to Say to Get Google Reviews: 12 Scripts That Work](https://www.ceoturbo.com/guides/what-to-say-to-get-google-reviews): Copy-and-paste scripts for asking for Google reviews in person, by text and email — for restaurants, salons, contractors and retail.
- [Google Review Cards for Restaurants, Salons & Contractors](https://www.ceoturbo.com/guides/google-review-cards-by-business): Where to put an NFC Google review card in a restaurant, salon, barbershop, contractor business, store, clinic or gym — and how many you need.
- [How to Track Booked Calls From Meta Ads (Pixel + CAPI)](https://www.ceoturbo.com/guides/track-booked-calls-meta-ads): Make Meta optimize for booked calls, not clicks: the Schedule event, Pixel + Conversions API with deduplication, calendar webhooks and testing.

## Answers

- SEO vs AEO vs GEO: what's the difference and which do you need? — SEO gets your page ranked. AEO gets a direct answer lifted from it. GEO gets your business named by AI assistants like ChatGPT and Perplexity. You need all three, in that order. (https://www.ceoturbo.com/guides/seo-vs-aeo-vs-geo)
- How much do Facebook ads cost per lead for a local business? (Real 2026 data) — Across seven Meta lead-form campaigns we ran in July–October 2026, clients got 147 leads for $1,103.43 — an average of $7.51 per lead. The cheapest was $4.31 (computer repair); the most expensive was $19.91 (outlet replacement). (https://www.ceoturbo.com/guides/facebook-ads-cost-per-lead)
- How to get your business recommended by ChatGPT and other AI assistants — AI assistants recommend businesses they can fetch, understand and verify. Make your site readable without JavaScript, answer buyer questions directly, keep your details identical everywhere, publish information only you have, and earn mentions on other sites. (https://www.ceoturbo.com/guides/how-to-get-recommended-by-chatgpt)
- Google Business Profile optimization checklist (2026) — Choose the most specific primary category, add every relevant secondary category, list all services with descriptions, turn on matching attributes, write a 750-character description, upload real photos weekly, post weekly and keep new reviews coming. (https://www.ceoturbo.com/guides/google-business-profile-checklist)
- How to get more Spotify listeners as an independent artist — Fix your profiles so every one points to your music, release on a steady schedule, pitch each release in Spotify for Artists at least seven days early, run small ads to your artist profile, and capture fans' emails so you're not dependent on any algorithm. (https://www.ceoturbo.com/guides/how-to-get-more-spotify-listeners)
- Shopify store getting visitors but no sales? 9 fixes — Most stores with traffic but no sales have a product-page problem, not a traffic problem: the offer is unclear, photos don't sell, objections go unanswered or checkout surprises the buyer. Fix the page, then the traffic. (https://www.ceoturbo.com/guides/shopify-visitors-no-sales)
- What a local business website needs to get more calls — A local website gets calls when the phone number, service and area are visible in the first screen, prices or starting prices are shown, real job photos and reviews prove the work, and the page loads fast on a phone. (https://www.ceoturbo.com/guides/local-business-website-checklist)
- How do I get more Google reviews for my business? — Ask every customer at the moment they're done — at checkout or when the job's finished — and make leaving a review one step. Your Google review link (from “Ask for reviews” in Business Profile) on an NFC tap card, receipts and follow-up texts does that. Never offer incentives or ask only happy customers. (https://www.ceoturbo.com/how-to-get-more-google-reviews)
- NFC Google review cards: do they work, and are they worth it? — An NFC Google review card stores your review link on a chip. A customer holds their phone near it and your Google review form opens — no app, no searching. They work on iPhone XS and newer and NFC Android phones, cost $15–$40 once, and get more reviews because they cut the ask to one tap. (https://www.ceoturbo.com/guides/nfc-google-review-cards)
- How to find your Google review link (and make it open the review form) — Your Google review link comes from your Google Business Profile: search your business name on Google while signed in, choose “Ask for reviews” (or “Read reviews” → “Get more reviews”) and copy the link. It looks like g.page/r/…/review and opens the review form directly. (https://www.ceoturbo.com/guides/how-to-find-google-review-link)
- Do NFC review cards work with iPhone and Android? — Yes. Every iPhone XS and newer reads NFC review cards automatically when unlocked — hold the top edge near the card. Most Android phones read them too once NFC is on (it usually is) — tap the middle of the back. iPhone 7, 8 and X can read them through the NFC Tag Reader in Control Center. (https://www.ceoturbo.com/guides/nfc-review-card-iphone-android)
- What to say to customers to get Google reviews (word-for-word scripts) — Ask at the moment the customer is happiest, make it personal, keep it one step, and never offer anything in return. The simplest script: “We're a small local business and reviews really help. Would you tap this and leave us a quick Google review?” (https://www.ceoturbo.com/guides/what-to-say-to-get-google-reviews)
- Google review cards for restaurants, salons, barbers, contractors and retail — Put the card where the customer is happiest and already holding their phone: the check presenter in a restaurant, each station in a salon or barbershop, the final walkthrough for contractors, and the register in retail. Most businesses need one card per place a customer finishes their visit. (https://www.ceoturbo.com/guides/google-review-cards-by-business)
- How to track booked calls from Meta ads (Pixel + Conversions API) — Fire Meta's standard Schedule event when a call is actually booked — not when the calendar opens — from both the browser Pixel and the Conversions API, with the same event ID so Meta counts it once. Then optimize your campaign for Schedule. That's what lets Meta find people who book, not just click. (https://www.ceoturbo.com/guides/track-booked-calls-meta-ads)
